If Nexa prefers self-billing (i.e., you generate the invoice on our behalf), we need an executed self-billing agreement and a sample invoice layout. Otherwise, we can reissue a corrected invoice showing Nexa Payments Ltd (Ireland) as the remittance/payee and include tax notes for customer accounting.

3) Timeline: Rafael and Marissa will review today and follow up with concrete next steps and a validation file you can attach to AP.

Hi all,

Quick update from Finance / Tax ops after running initial checks: 

- I validated the VAT number you gave using VIES and our internal matching rules. The number does validate but flags as a Northern Ireland (XI) registration depending on the format used. I've attached our short validation extract.
- Because you are asking to have payment routed to Nexa Payments Ltd (Ireland), we need one of the following before we can reissue the invoice: 
  * A copy of Nexa Payments Ltd company registration (CRO) showing the Irish company as an active legal entity, or
  * A signed self-billing agreement that explicitly authorizes Redwood to accept invoices on your behalf and confirms the VAT handling.
- If you want us to apply reverse-charge wording on the invoice (i.e., 'VAT accounted for by the recipient'), we can add standard EU reverse-charge text. However, reverse-charge only applies if taxable supply occurs between EU/UK registrants per local rules — we will need your cert that you will account for VAT in Ireland.

Please attach one of the requested docs and confirm preferred invoice remittance details (company name, billing address, bank details mask for the invoice body). Once we have that, we'll reissue Invoice 20260731 as a corrected invoice; expected turnaround ~2 business days.

Best regards,
